items.title: Find Your Way Around
items.subtitle: Home, You, Settings, and the assistant button
items.content:
Ritualist is organized into three tabs plus one shortcut:

• Home — today's habits, the calendar, and quick logging.
• You — streaks, challenges, achievements, patterns, history, and About You.
• Settings — your profile, preferences, permissions, sync, and help.
• The ✦ button next to the tabs opens the Habits Gallery, where you add new habits.

You can also long-press the Ritualist app icon for shortcuts such as adding a habit or opening the gallery.

items.title: Habits Gallery
items.subtitle: Add ready-made habits in a tap
items.content:
Tap the ✦ button to open the Habits Gallery. It offers well over a hundred ready-made habits, each with a name, emoji, color, schedule, and target already set up.

• Browse by category (Health, Wellness, Productivity, Learning, and more) using the filters at the top.
• "New" shows recently added suggestions; "Added" shows the habits you already added so you can remove them.
• Use the search button to find a habit by name.
• Tap + on a suggestion to add it.

The gallery also includes fasting protocols, breathing exercises, and habits linked to Apple Health, such as steps, exercise minutes, water, sleep, and mindful minutes.

items.title: Create Your Own Habit
items.subtitle: Build a habit from scratch
items.content:
Open the Habits Gallery with the ✦ button and tap + at the top left (Create New Habit).

1. Pick an emoji, type a name, and choose a color.
2. Under Tracking, choose Check off, Amount, or Timed.
3. Under Schedule, choose Daily or Specific Days.
4. Choose a category (required). Tap the gear icon to manage categories.
5. Under Support your habit, add reminders if you want them.
6. Tap Add Habit.

If something is missing, Ritualist scrolls to the field that needs your attention.

items.title: Check Off, Amount, or Timed
items.subtitle: Choose how a habit is tracked
items.content:
• Check off — mark it done once on each scheduled day. Great for "Meditate" or "Take vitamins".
• Amount — track a quantity toward a daily target, with a unit you choose, like "8 glasses" or "30 minutes".
• Timed — run a fasting or breathing session with a built-in timer. Choose Fasting or Breathing, then a protocol.

For timed fasting habits you can also set a start time and turn on a reminder to start fasting.

items.title: Schedules and Start Dates
items.subtitle: Daily or on specific days
items.content:
Choose Daily for habits you do every day, or Specific Days to pick weekdays, like Monday, Wednesday, and Friday for a workout. A habit only counts toward your progress and streaks on its scheduled days.

When you edit a habit, Active Since shows the first day it can be logged. You can't log it before that date, and the start date can't be moved after your first log.

items.title: Categories
items.subtitle: Group related habits
items.content:
Every habit belongs to a category, such as Health, Career, or Finance. Categories power the category filters on Home and the Category Performance chart on the You tab.

To add, rename, deactivate, or delete categories, tap the gear icon in the Category section while creating or editing a habit. Deactivated categories are hidden when creating habits, but their existing habits stay.

items.title: Free and Pro
items.subtitle: What's included in each plan
items.content:
Free includes core tracking for up to 5 active habits, timed habits, streaks, challenges, achievements, progress charts, Apple Health, time and location reminders, iCloud sync, Apple Watch, and saving backups.

Ritualist Pro adds:
• Unlimited active habits
• About You personality insights and the About You widget
• Smart Scheduling shortcuts that turn suggestions into reminders and schedules
• Restoring data from a backup

Subscribe from any Pro prompt. Manage or restore your subscription in Settings. If you go over the free limit, for example after a subscription ends, deactivate habits until you are within it, or upgrade.

items.title: Your Home Screen
items.subtitle: Today at a glance
items.content:
Home shows the habits scheduled for the selected day.

• Tap a day in the week strip, or swipe left and right across the habit list, to change days.
• Tap the calendar button at the top to switch between the week strip and a full month calendar.
• Each day shows its progress. Fully completed days are highlighted, and partial days show how far you got.
• When category filters are turned on, tap a category above the list to focus on it.

You can browse future days, but you can only log today and past days.

items.title: Log a Habit
items.subtitle: Tap a habit to record progress
items.content:
Tap a habit card to open its progress sheet:

• Check off habits: tap Mark as Completed.
• Amount habits: use the + and − buttons or the quick amount buttons, or tap Complete All to reach your target in one step.
• Timed habits: start, follow, and finish your session.

The button on the right side of each card is a shortcut: complete a habit, log an amount, or start and stop a timed session without opening the sheet. Tap a completed habit to adjust it or mark it as not completed.

items.title: Swipe Actions and the More Menu
items.subtitle: Faster ways to act on a habit
items.content:
• Swipe left on a habit card for quick actions, such as Complete, Log, Reset, Start, or Finish.
• Swipe right on a habit card to Edit it.
• Tap the ••• button on a card for the same quick actions plus Completion History and Edit.

Reset asks for confirmation before it removes the day's progress.

items.title: Log Past Days
items.subtitle: Catch up on missed entries
items.content:
Forgot to log yesterday? Select that day on Home and log it as usual. You can also remove a log if you made a mistake.

For timed habits, use Log a fast or Log a Session to add a session you didn't track live, including its start and end time.

items.title: Streaks
items.subtitle: Stay consistent day after day
items.content:
Complete a habit on consecutive scheduled days to build a streak. Days that aren't scheduled don't break it.

Open Streaks on the You tab to see every active streak and how many days remain until the next level. On Home, a habit card can show when a streak is at risk, meaning you still need to complete it today to keep the streak alive. You can hide these indicators in Settings → Preferences.

items.title: Edit, Pause, or Delete a Habit
items.subtitle: Change a habit without losing history
items.content:
Swipe right on a habit, or choose Edit from its ••• menu. Change anything you set up when you created it, then tap Save Changes.

At the bottom of the editor, under Manage:
• Deactivate pauses a habit. It stays on Home, dimmed, and you can bring it back with Reactivate from its ••• menu.
• Delete removes the habit and all of its data. This can't be undone.

If you leave the editor with unsaved changes, Ritualist asks whether to discard them.

items.title: Fasting Tracker
items.subtitle: Track intermittent and extended fasts
items.content:
Create a Timed habit and choose Fasting, or add a fasting protocol from the Habits Gallery. Built-in protocols range from 12:12, 14:10, 16:8, 18:6, and 24:0 to 36h, 48h, 72h, 5-Day, and 7-Day. You can also create your own with Create Protocol.

Start a fast from its card or sheet. While it runs you can:
• Tap the timer to switch between elapsed and remaining time.
• Use Adjust Time if you started earlier, or Adjust Goal to change the target.
• Follow the stages at 25%, 50%, and 75%, plus the Insights guidance for each phase.

Tap Finish when you're done, then choose Save & End to keep the fast or Discard to remove it. If a fast is left running unexpectedly, Ritualist shows it as an Unfinished Fast so you can resume or discard it.

The first time you use fasting, you'll be asked to read and accept a health disclaimer.

items.title: Fasting Alerts
items.subtitle: Updates at every stage of your fast
items.content:
While you fast, Ritualist can notify you at 25%, 50%, and 75% of your goal, in the final minutes, when you reach your goal, and shortly after you go past it. Each alert can include a short pep talk.

Expand a fasting notification to see your live progress and finish the fast right from there. Alerts follow your fast and move when you adjust it.

Choose which stages notify you in Settings → Notifications → Fasting alerts. Breathing sessions don't send stage alerts.

items.title: Breathing Exercises
items.subtitle: Guided breathing with proven patterns
items.content:
Create a Timed habit and choose Breathing, or add one from the Habits Gallery. Built-in patterns include Box Breathing, 4-7-8 Relaxation, Cyclic Sighing, Coherent Breathing, Calming Breath, Power Breathing, and Energizing Breath.

To make your own, tap Create Breathing Pattern and set the inhale, hold after inhale, exhale, hold after exhale, and number of rounds.

During a session, an animated guide shows the current phase, the seconds left, and your round. You can pause and resume. If you stop early, Save & Stop keeps the rounds you completed.

items.title: Live Activities
items.subtitle: Follow your fast from the Lock Screen
items.content:
When you start a fast, a Live Activity appears on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island. It shows your elapsed and remaining time, a progress bar, and short encouragement, and it stays up to date while the app is closed.

Tap the Live Activity to jump back to your fast, or tap Finish to end it with the usual Save & End or Discard choice.

On iPhones that support Apple Intelligence, pep talks are generated privately on your device. Live Activities are available for fasting only.

items.title: Session History and Mood
items.subtitle: See how sessions affect you
items.content:
Every timed habit keeps a history of its sessions, including whether you met your goal. Tap a session to expand it, edit its times, or delete it. Deleting a session removes only its time from that day's total.

You can log how you feel with each session:
• Fasting: Great, Good, Neutral, Tired, or Struggling.
• Breathing: Calm, Focused, Good, Neutral, Anxious, or Restless.

Add an optional note to remember what made a session easy or hard.

items.title: Time Reminders
items.subtitle: Get notified at the right moment
items.content:
While creating or editing a habit, open Reminders under Support your habit and add one or more times.

Reminders only arrive on days the habit is scheduled, and they stay quiet when you've already completed the habit or a fast is already running.

If a reminder time passes without a log, a catch-up reminder can nudge you. You can turn that off in Settings → Notifications.

items.title: Location Reminders
items.subtitle: Reminders based on where you are
items.content:
Open Reminders in the habit editor and add a location. Pick a saved favorite, search for a place, use your current location, or adjust the pin on the map.

• Choose Arriving, Leaving, or Both.
• Adjust the Area Size if the reminder triggers too early or too late.
• Set the Notification Frequency so you aren't reminded too often while you stay there.

Location reminders need Always location access so they work when Ritualist isn't open. Check the status in Settings → Location.

items.title: Smart Scheduling
items.subtitle: Suggestions based on your own patterns
items.content:
Once you've logged a habit for a while, its editor shows Smart Scheduling: the time you usually complete it and the weekdays you're most successful.

With Pro, turn a suggestion into action: tap Add Reminder to create a reminder at your usual time, or Use these days to apply the suggested days to the schedule.

items.title: Choose Your Notifications
items.subtitle: Decide what gets your attention
items.content:
Open Settings → Notifications. The top shows whether notifications are allowed, with a shortcut to fix it if they aren't.

Below, turn each type on or off:
• Habits: habit reminders, catch-up reminders, location reminders, and automatic completions from Apple Health.
• Fasting: start reminders and Fasting alerts.
• Breathing: session reminders.
• Progress: streak milestones, achievements, and challenges.
• About You: analysis updates.

Turning a type off also removes the notifications already scheduled for it.

items.title: The You Tab
items.subtitle: All your progress in one place
items.content:
The You tab brings your progress together in cards:

• Challenges — join paths and complete milestones.
• Streaks — your active streaks and next levels.
• About You — insights from your habit patterns.
• Patterns — your best days, weak spots, and category performance.
• History — trends, best runs, and the completion calendar.

Tap any card to open its details.

items.title: Patterns
items.subtitle: Discover when and where you do best
items.content:
Open Patterns on the You tab.

• Your Weekly Rhythm shows your completion rate for each day of the week. Use it to schedule demanding habits on your strongest days.
• Category Performance compares categories so you can see which areas of life are thriving and which need a simpler plan. Tap a category to see its habits.

Tap the info button on a chart for an explanation and examples.

items.title: History and Completion Calendar
items.subtitle: Track improvement over time
items.content:
Open History on the You tab and choose a period: Last 7 Days, Last 31 Days, Current Week, Current Month, or Last 3 Months.

• Progress Trend charts your daily completion rate. Tap or drag on the chart to explore days.
• Your Best Runs shows your perfect days (every scheduled habit done), your peak run of perfect days, and a consistency score.
• Completion Calendar shows which days each habit was completed. Select a habit or view all habits together.

For a single habit, choose Completion History from its ••• menu on Home.

items.title: Challenges
items.subtitle: Follow a path and earn a reward
items.content:
Challenges are paths made of milestones, such as holding a 7-day streak, completing perfect days, or reviewing weekly recaps. Finish them all to earn a reward achievement.

Open Challenges on the You tab to browse them:
• Some challenges are always open, while monthly and seasonal ones are only available for a limited time.
• Tap Join Challenge to start tracking your progress.
• Turn on Show on Home to keep a joined challenge in the Home carousel.
• Leave Challenge stops tracking. Achievements you already earned stay.

Challenges that close before you finish them move to Missed.

items.title: Achievements
items.subtitle: Celebrate milestones as you go
items.content:
Achievements unlock automatically as you use Ritualist, with no setup needed. They're grouped into:

• Streaks — from 3 days up to 7, 14, 30, 50, 100, and 365 days.
• Perfect Days — completing every scheduled habit on 1, 3, 5, and 20 days.
• Consistency — tracking 1, 3, 5, and 10 active habits.
• Weekly Recaps — looking back on your weeks.
• Challenge Rewards — finishing a challenge.

Open Achievements from the Challenges screen or the Home carousel. Filter by locked or unlocked, tap a badge to see how to unlock it, and tap Share to send a card to friends.

items.title: Shareable Cards
items.subtitle: Show off a great day or week
items.content:
Ritualist creates a shareable card when there's something worth celebrating:

• Streak Milestone — when a streak reaches a new milestone.
• Perfect Day — when you complete every habit scheduled for the day.
• Weekly Recap — your week in review, with your completion rate, best day, and top streak.

Each card has a QR code that links to Ritualist on the App Store. Share it, or dismiss it if you'd rather not.

items.title: About You Insights
items.subtitle: Personality insights from your habits
items.content:
About You looks at your habit patterns to estimate personality traits and suggest habits that fit you. It's optional, and it's a Pro feature.

• Before the first analysis, review what data is used and tap Allow Analysis.
• The analysis runs entirely on your device, and the result isn't synced to iCloud.
• It needs at least 5 active habits in 2 or more categories, 7 days of tracking (14 for monthly analysis), and some completions in the last 30 days. The About You card on the You tab shows your progress toward these.
• Choose an Analysis Frequency: Daily, Weekly, Monthly, or Only When I Ask.

You can Withdraw Consent at any time. That turns off About You and deletes the generated profile, but not your habits or logs. About You offers guidance, not a medical or psychological assessment.

items.title: Apple Health
items.subtitle: Track habits with Health data
items.content:
Habits from the Habits Gallery that match a Health metric, such as steps, walking and running distance, exercise minutes, stand hours, active calories, water, caffeine, sleep, mindful minutes, or weight, can connect to Apple Health.

In the habit editor, open Apple Health to choose how it syncs:
• Read from Health — the habit completes automatically when Health data reaches your goal. Progress comes from Health, so manual input is turned off.
• Write to Health — completing the habit logs the data to Apple Health.
• Two-way Sync — changes flow in both directions.

When you connect an existing habit, you can sync its past logs to Apple Health. Settings → Apple Health shows which metrics are connected and lets you request access to the rest.

items.title: iCloud Sync
items.subtitle: Your habits on all your devices
items.content:
Your habits, categories, progress, and profile sync automatically across devices signed in to the same iCloud account. There's nothing to set up, and it's free.

Settings → iCloud Sync shows the current status and what syncs, with troubleshooting steps if something is wrong.

Some things stay on each device by design, such as your About You result and the consents you've given.

items.title: Apple Watch
items.subtitle: Track from your wrist
items.content:
Open Ritualist on your Apple Watch to see today's habits and your progress.

• Mark check-off habits complete and adjust amounts.
• Start, end, or discard fasting and breathing sessions. Accept the disclaimer on your iPhone first.
• Habits managed by Apple Health show where their progress comes from.

Changes sync with your iPhone right away when both devices are connected, and they're saved until they can sync when they aren't. Add new habits and resolve unfinished fasts on your iPhone.

items.title: Home Screen Widgets
items.subtitle: Progress at a glance
items.content:
Add Ritualist widgets to your Home Screen:

• Habit Calendar — your completion history in a calendar.
• Habit Streaks — your current streaks.
• Active Challenges — the challenges closest to their deadline.
• About You — insights from your habit patterns (Pro).

Touch and hold an empty area of your Home Screen, tap Edit → Add Widget, and search for Ritualist.

items.title: Backups and Your Data
items.subtitle: Save, restore, or delete your data
items.content:
Open Settings → Manage Data.

• Save Backup exports your habits, categories, logs, and profile to a file you can keep anywhere.
• Restore Backup brings a saved backup back into Ritualist (Pro).
• Delete All Data permanently removes your habits and data from this device and, when sync is on, from iCloud. This can't be undone, so save a backup first.

items.title: Preferences
items.subtitle: Appearance, language, and feedback
items.content:
Open Settings → Preferences to:

• Choose System, Light, or Dark appearance.
• Turn Haptic Feedback on or off.
• Pick a language: English, German, Spanish, French, or Romanian. Restart Ritualist for the change to take effect.
• Set your Timezone.
• Choose which habit indicators and risk indicators appear on habit cards.

Reset Preferences returns these settings to their defaults.

items.title: Customize Home
items.subtitle: Keep only what you need
items.content:
Open Settings → Preferences → Customize Home.

• Default calendar view: start Home with the week strip or the month calendar. The calendar button on Home still switches temporarily.
• Show on Home: choose whether the carousel shows the customization card, inspirational messages, and challenges, and whether category filters appear above your habits.

You can also hide a carousel card directly from Home.

items.title: Your Profile
items.subtitle: Name, photo, and personalized suggestions
items.content:
Open Settings → Profile to set your name and photo. Your name can appear in greetings and notifications.

Optional details, such as your age group, help tailor the suggestions in the Habits Gallery. Profile information syncs through your private iCloud database when iCloud sync is available.

items.title: Travel and Timezones
items.subtitle: Keep days lined up when you travel
items.content:
Ritualist decides when each day starts and ends based on your timezone setting. In Settings → Preferences → Timezone, choose whether to follow your current location, keep your home timezone while traveling, or use a specific timezone.

When Ritualist notices a new timezone, it asks what to do. Choose Keep Home Time while traveling, or I Moved Here if you've relocated.

items.title: Ritualist Labs
items.subtitle: Try experimental features
items.content:
Settings → Ritualist Labs has beta features you can turn on:

• Timeline — scroll vertically through days on Home instead of using the classic layout.
• Day progress — show calendar progress as a Fill or a Ring.
• Smart Check-Ins — gentle nudges at your usual time for habits without reminders.
• Tips — short guidance for habit actions and new features.

Beta features may change or be removed as they improve.

items.title: Start Small
items.subtitle: Build momentum gradually
items.content: Begin with 1–3 habits and master them before adding more. It's better to complete a few habits consistently than to struggle with many. Success builds the confidence and motivation you need for bigger goals.

items.title: Habit Stacking
items.subtitle: Link new habits to existing ones
items.content: Attach a new habit to a routine you already have. For example: "After I pour my morning coffee, I will meditate for 5 minutes." The existing routine becomes the trigger, which makes the new habit easier to remember. A time or location reminder can reinforce the link.

items.title: The 2-Minute Rule
items.subtitle: Make habits easy to start
items.content: Scale any habit down to something you can do in 2 minutes or less. "Read 30 minutes" becomes "Read one page". Once you start, you often keep going. The goal is to make starting so easy you can't say no. With an Amount habit, begin with a small target and raise it later.

items.title: Help, Feedback, and What's Next
items.subtitle: Get answers and shape Ritualist
items.content:
Open Settings → Help & Feedback:

• User Guide — this guide.
• FAQ — answers to common questions.
• Support — email the Ritualist team.
• Coming Up — see what's planned, vote for the features you want most, or tap Suggest a Feature to send your idea.

Settings → What's New lists the highlights of every release.
